blocks.text: Japanese volleyball player Rui Takahashi came out as gay on Tuesday, saying he wanted to help others struggling with their sexuality in a country where openly LGBTQ athletes are extremely rare. The 26-year-old Takahashi, who plays in the top division of Japan’s professional volleyball league, posted a statement on social media accompanied by a black-and-white photo of himself.
